name: BougeRV Rocky V3.0 55QT Dual Zone Portable Car Cooler
summary: A 55 QT / 52 L dual-zone portable fridge for a powered vehicle or camp base. Independent zone settings offer flexibility; a battery, solar panel, phone and illustrated contents are not promised with the Amazon offer.
description: Rocky V3.0 adds independently controlled compartments for a trip where chilled and frozen supplies need different settings. The documented 55QT model uses a metal-and-plastic body and supports app control, but the physical controls and actual compartment temperatures still matter. Build a power and ventilation plan before relying on it during an outage. The promotional phone, cans and battery-style compartment are visual context; they do not establish what the selected Canadian Amazon package includes.

pros: Separate settings can serve different cold-storage needs in one portable unit.
The model family provides DC and adapter-based AC power options for a planned vehicle or camp setup.
cons: A dual-zone fridge still needs an adequate power source, ventilation and monitored storage temperatures.
The current Canadian Amazon variant, battery bundle and exact accessory list are not independently verified.
App imagery, displayed readings and advertised energy figures are not an independent cooling or runtime test.
useCases: Plan separately monitored chilled and frozen compartments for a powered camp base.
Compare running demand and replenishment options for vehicle travel or a limited blackout food-storage plan.

safetyNotes: Use the specified supply, correctly rated cable and protective fuse. Keep connectors dry, inspect cables and leave cooling vents clear; follow the delivered instructions.
A vehicle low-voltage cut-off is not a guarantee that the starter battery can still crank the engine. Plan a suitable supply and reserve energy; do not assume a built-in battery.
Check storage temperature with a separate thermometer: refrigerate at or below 4°C and freeze at or below −18°C. A display setting alone does not show that food has stayed safe during an outage.
Keep raw foods contained, minimize lid openings and follow food-safety advice after loss of cooling. No guaranteed battery runtime, uninterrupted cold chain or physical performance test is claimed.
